weather_sensing_prompt: Inspect this image carefully for atmospheric weather or lighting degradations: rain streaks, falling snow, atmospheric haze/fog, or severe low-light underexposure. Return strictly a JSON object with boolean keys: {"rain": false, "snow": false, "haze": false, "lowlight": false}.
text_detection_prompt: Locate ALL text, words, letters, numbers, captions, logos, or signboards visible in this image (even if blurry, small, low-resolution, or centered). Return strictly a JSON list of bounding boxes in 0-1000 normalized coordinates like [{"bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}]. If absolutely no text or letters exist anywhere in the image, return [].
ocr_read_prompt: Read the exact text, letters, or numbers shown in this cropped signboard or word image. Output ONLY the exact characters you can clearly read. If completely unreadable, output UNREADABLE.

restoration_prompts.universal_blind: Restore <Picture 1> to clean, sharp high quality if degraded, or return <Picture 1> unchanged if already clean. Preserve the exact original scene content, composition, object shapes and positions, text and numbers, colors, exposure, fine structures, and natural textures. Do not add, remove, or reinterpret objects or details.
restoration_prompts.denoise: Cleanly remove all sensor noise, color speckle, and grain from <Picture 1> to produce a crisp, clean, natural noise-free photograph. Strictly preserve every exact original pixel position, edge contour, color, tone, text, and fine natural structure without zooming, shifting, or re-imagining textures.
restoration_prompts.motion_deblur: Refine <Picture 1> to a crisp, natural, sharp high-resolution photograph: eliminate any residual motion-blur ghosting, deconvolution ringing, or edge softness while strictly locking the exact deblurred object positions, edge phases, character strokes, colors, and exposure. Do not shift edges or invent fake details.
restoration_prompts.real_sr: Super-resolve <Picture 1> to clean, sharp native high resolution while removing camera noise, lens blur, ringing, and compression artifacts. Preserve the exact original scene content, composition, object shapes and positions, text and numbers, colors, exposure, fine structures, and natural textures. Do not add, remove, or reinterpret objects or details.
restoration_prompts.jpeg: Remove JPEG compression blocking and ringing artifacts from <Picture 1>. Preserve the exact original scene content, composition, object shapes and positions, text and numbers, colors, exposure, fine structures, and natural textures. Do not add, remove, or reinterpret objects or details.
restoration_prompts.text_zoom_generic: Restore <Picture 1> to a crisp, clean, high-resolution signboard photograph while strictly preserving every exact character stroke, radical topology, letter shape, sign boundary, and original color. Do not invent, replace, or alter any characters.
restoration_prompts.derain: Completely remove all falling rain streaks, rain lines, and raindrop artifacts from <Picture 1> to restore a crystal-clear, clean, sharp photograph. Preserve the exact underlying scene content, object shapes, colors, natural lighting, text, and fine background textures.
restoration_prompts.desnow: Completely remove all falling snowflakes, snow particles, and snow streaks in the air from <Picture 1> to restore a crystal-clear, clean, sharp photograph. Preserve the exact underlying scene content, object geometry, natural colors, text, and fine background textures.
restoration_prompts.dehaze: Completely remove all atmospheric haze, fog, mist, and milky airlight veil from <Picture 1> to restore crystal-clear visibility, deep natural contrast, vivid true colors, and sharp distant details. Preserve the exact scene geometry, object shapes, text, and structures.
restoration_prompts.lowlight: Brighten and restore <Picture 1> from dark low-light underexposure to a bright, clear, well-lit natural daylight exposure with balanced contrast, vivid accurate colors, and clean noise-free shadow details. Preserve the exact scene content, object shapes, text, and textures.
